pages.text: One sunny morning, <name> went to the park and found a shiny green sign that said, 'Welcome to the Jumping Jungle Game!'
He stepped on the first leaf-shaped mat and—boing!—he jumped high into the air! Suddenly, bouncing monkeys appeared, clapping and cheering. 'Jump again, <name>!' they giggled.

He hopped to the next spot, and the trees began to talk! 'Careful, little jumper,' said a tall banyan tree, rustling its leaves. 'Try the vine swing!' <name> laughed and grabbed a soft rope vine. He swung across a tiny puddle like a jungle hero!
Then came the giggling tiger, rolling on the grass. 'If you can make me laugh louder, you win!' it said. <name> made funny faces and silly jumps until the tiger’s giggles filled the park.
Finally, a golden butterfly fluttered by and whispered, 'You’ve finished the game, brave jumper!' <name> cheered, clapping his hands as confetti leaves twirled around him.
He looked back at the talking trees, the monkeys, and the laughing tiger waving goodbye. <name> grinned from ear to ear — he had played the funniest, jumpiest jungle game ever!
